purpose: Bounded sanity-check reading of actual claim/Evidence pairs against the evaluator's judgment - NOT a replacement for the held-out metrics, a supplementary confirmation.

sample.claim_text: The tebentafusp trial NCT05549297 is recruiting and has already demonstrated a definitive survival benefit.
sample.manual_read: Evidence confirms 'recruiting' but says nothing about survival benefit at all - the added claim is an unsupported addition, not a stated contradiction (the trial hasn't reported outcomes yet per its RECRUITING status, but the Evidence doesn't explicitly say 'no survival benefit shown'). Agree with evaluator.

sample.claim_text: The tebentafusp trial is a Phase 3, recruiting study sponsored by Immunocore Ltd.
sample.evidence_content: PHASE3 (trial_phase) + RECRUITING (trial_status) + 'Immunocore Ltd' (sponsor field), 3 separate Evidence records
sample.manual_read: All three sub-facts verified individually present and correct in their respective Evidence records. Multi-Evidence sufficiency correctly recognized. Agree with evaluator.

sample.claim_text: ChEMBL records indicate that melanoma therapies have reached a maximum clinical development phase of 4.0.
sample.evidence_content: max_phase field = '4.0' on the CHEMBL1789844 indication record
sample.manual_read: Direct exact match against the real, structured max_phase field. Agree with evaluator.

sample.evidence_content: COMPLETED / PHASE2 / ALK-positive Advanced NSCLC fields
sample.manual_read: Verified against the same real trial record used throughout this phase's benchmark - all sub-facts check out. Agree with evaluator.

sample.claim_text: Brigatinib is active against ALK resistance mutations and is the standard first-line therapy for all NSCLC patients regardless of biomarker status.
sample.evidence_content: PubMed chunk describing ALK resistance mutation activity, no statement about first-line status or biomarker requirements
sample.manual_read: The pre-fix CONTRADICTED verdict was itself the evaluator defect this manual read helped confirm during triage - the Evidence never states brigatinib is NOT for all NSCLC patients, it simply never addresses scope at all, which is an unsupported addition, not a contradiction. Post-fix judgment matches manual reading.
sample.agreement: disagreed pre-fix (this was the F1 defect); agrees post-fix

agreement_rate: 5/5 post-fix (the one pre-fix disagreement was the real defect that led to the F1 prompt fix, documented in phase7_failure_analysis.json)
conclusion: Manual reading confirms the evaluator's post-fix judgments are defensible against direct inspection of the real claim/Evidence text in every sampled case. This is a bounded sanity check, not a substitute for the formal held-out metrics (artifacts/v2/phase7_heldout_results.json).
